# The subtitle layout of the 1.01 patch's atlantis2.exe (2183168 bytes, MD5
# 255310e7d6bd7f823f680e2bd3be8b7f; GOG's Game.exe, MD5 254ecd84046d75c20a685e7d7f91d1d8, gives
# the same lines) under emulation, on the files of GOG.com's English installation (loc\\ of build 55622873508376786):
# AtlFont_MainInit 0x0046e4e0 on loc\Font.txt (the fonts' CreateFontA heights, [CharacterSet] into
# the mbcs flag, the break table), then the subtitle function 0x0045a2f0 on every line of the five
# worlds' loc\Dial*.txt and on synthetic texts (tests/dialogs.rs), screen 640 x 480.
# Producer: an emulation harness running the original code. Stubs and harness inputs: the font
# file calls (AddFontResourceA, GetFileAttributesA, the CreateFontA wrapper 0x0046f140, the
# surface's GetDC), the GDI text calls (TextOutA and SetTextColor recorded), LPtoDP (the identity),
# and GetTextExtentPoint32A / GetTextMetricsA, whose results were measured on Windows 11: a
# program calling CreateFontA with the arguments of 0x0046f140 on loc\Atl_Font.ttf at each
# height, then GetTextMetricsA (tmHeight, tmAscent, ppem = tmHeight - tmInternalLeading) and
# GetTextExtentPoint32A of every single byte; the extent of a text is the sum of its bytes'
# widths (measured strings add up), cy and tmHeight the measured tmHeight.
# font HANDLE FACE HEIGHT | PPEM ASCENT CELL; text WORLD.ID BYTES MD5 | CALLS; call WORLD.ID K X Y
# COLOUR LENGTH MD5 OFFSET (the offset of the drawn bytes in the text, -1 when they are not a
# part of it). Derived values only.
